findings.passage: Texans demand honest and fair elections. Texas' Voter ID Law ensures the integrity of the democratic process by putting measures in place to prevent voter fraud.
findings.note: Official Senate press statement reacting to a federal judge's ruling against the Texas photo ID law; she says the law ensures election integrity and that the Supreme Court has ruled such laws constitutional.

findings.passage: "Voter ID Laws provide some protection against voter fraud, but they are only part of the solution," Senator Campbell stated.
findings.note: Press release on filing SB 120 (84th session), raising ballot theft to a third-degree felony; she links the need to more people voting by mail.

findings.passage: Voter ID laws like the one Texas passed help safeguard honest elections and secure the right of every law-abiding citizen to have their ballot count.
findings.note: Official statement after the 5th Circuit ruled the 2011 photo ID law did not comply with parts of the Voting Rights Act; she disagrees with the ruling.

findings.passage: We have learned many times over that there is no such thing as a gun free zone. Those with evil intentions will violate the law and carry out their heinous acts no matter what," Senator Campbell stated. "It makes no sense to disarm the good guys and leave law-abiding citizens defenseless where violent offenders break the law to do great harm.
findings.note: Official press release on filing SB 535 (carry in churches). Month taken from the file name of the release; the release text gives no date.

findings.passage: The existing statute is confusing and clunky when it comes to clearly stating the rights of licensed Texans to carry on the premises of a church," said Senator Campbell. "This bill provides clarity of the Legislature's intent to treat churches in the same manner as other privately owned establishments in Texas.
findings.note: Same release, on why SB 535 is needed.
Filed SB 535 to secure the right of licensed Texans to carry in churches; it also lowers penalties for licence holders who carry unknowingly in prohibited places.

findings.passage: Statistics show that concealed handgun license holders are the safest, most responsible gun owners in Texas. It makes no sense to force hospitals and nursing homes to disarm the good guys while violent offenders break the law," Senator Campbell said.
findings.note: Official press release on filing SB 311 to remove carry restrictions at hospitals and nursing homes.
Filed SB 311, the 'Clarity to Carry' bill, removing state restrictions that kept hospitals and nursing homes from letting licence holders carry on their premises.

findings.passage: I am proud to join Senator Birdwell and my conservative colleagues in the Senate in authoring this vital Second Amendment legislation.
findings.note: Statement in the official release on joining the filing of SB 11, campus carry.

findings.passage: It's time to stop the idiocy of creating unsafe zones that disarm the good guys while violent offenders break the law.
findings.note: Same release, on gun-free zones on campuses.
Joined Sen. Birdwell in filing SB 11, the Campus Personal Protection Act, letting licensed adults carry concealed handguns on public university campuses.

findings.passage: CHL holders make our environment more secure from criminals, not less.
findings.note: Statement in the official release after the Senate vote moving SB 11 (campus carry) out of the Senate.

findings.passage: I am pleased to join Senator Birdwell in authoring this legislation to strengthen our second amendment rights,
findings.note: Same release; the sentence continues past this line on the page.
A gun-rights group's page says she authored and passed Senate Bill 20, on hotel guests keeping lawfully owned firearms and ammunition in their rooms. Third-party source; the page date is 2021-09-10.
The same gun-rights group's page says she co-sponsored HB 1927, which lets adults 21 or older carry a handgun without a state licence. Third-party source; her vote is on file separately.
